title: veronicastrum laciniatum
intro: Veronicastrum laciniatum, commonly known as Cutleaf Spiked Speedwell, is a flowering plant in the borage family (Boraginaceae). This plant is known for its unique, cut-leaved foliage and spikes of blue or white flowers that attract pollinators. The health benefits of Veronicastrum laciniatum include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing.
